elements.label: Google Drive icon tile grey flash

pattern.description: In a closer crop of the connector tray (new shot s002), the Drive tile flashes to a darkened grey state at f191 and snaps back, then the Slack tile goes grey at f199 and is still grey at the end frame.
pattern.why_premium: The flashes sit on music transients, so a static logo row gets a rhythmic, tactile pulse that walks the eye from one integration to the next with no layout motion.

build_hint.gsap: Per tile in order, `.set(tile, {filter: 'brightness(0.55) saturate(0.6)'}, beatTime)` then `.set(tile, {filter: 'none'}, beatTime + 0.067)`; step changes only, beat-spaced (about 0.27 s) rather than a fixed stagger.
build_hint.remotion: Per tile index i, `const on = frame >= beatFrames[i] && frame < beatFrames[i] + 2;` with `filter: on ? 'brightness(0.55)' : 'none'`, no interpolate; beatFrames from the music beat list.

notes: b02 is a union box that also covers Slack; used for Drive because no Drive-only box exists, and b01 (Slack diff box) is taken by Slack. Slack is still grey at end frame f205, so its flash may last longer than the Drive one or the end frame may sit inside the flash. Same recurring pattern as e002, e004 and e006.
